{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read the data with proper handling of revenue as numeric
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv', dtype={'revenue': 'string'})

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any remaining non-numeric values
print("Non-numeric revenue values after conversion:", sales['revenue'].isna().sum(), "rows marked as NaN")

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue}')"}
